574:t_1:84.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No matter how much debt I end up carrying, I've got a reason I have to go home...」

574:t_1:85.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「So... since this is all about debt anyway, there's no point trying to look cool.」

574:t_1:86.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And in his case... paying off his debt is one of the reasons he has to return.」

574:t_1:87.en:
$$五飛$$
「So it comes down to that in the end.」

574:t_1:88.en:
$n
「So this unwavering steadiness is the swaying scales, huh...」

574:t_1:89.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Attention, all $c personnel. We've confirmed a distortion in the dimensional boundary line 50 kilometers east of here.」

574:t_1:90.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Meaning that's the spot where the $$トレミー$$ was transferred?」

574:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I heard it from $$マルグリット$$ once... That's the place where the $$破界の王$$ first appeared in $$インサラウム$$.」

574:t_1:96.en:
$$赤木$$
「So $$ガイオウ$$ really is coming...!」

574:t_1:98.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...We've got no choice but to go.」

574:t_2:4.en:
???
「...Looks like they were trying to draw me into this world.」

574:t_2:5.en:
???
「Even if I am a defeated general, anyone who thinks they can do whatever they want with me using a mere $$イドム$$ is dead wrong.」

574:t_2:8.en:
???
「Not a bad ring to it, but I have the name my parents gave me, and the name of $$次元将$$ $$ヴァイシュラバ$$.」

574:t_2:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「So that's $$ガイオウ$$'s real name...!」

574:t_2:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Do you mean to turn us into $$次元獣$$s?」

574:t_2:12.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「Not only are you fighting them, you even know about the existence of $$次元獣$$s...」

574:t_2:13.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「Looks like you lot are my comrades.」

574:t_2:14.en:
$$シモン$$
「Where are you planning to go?」

574:t_2:15.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「...I meant to rebuild my army in this world, but with guys like you around, there's no part left for me to play.」

574:t_2:16.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「I'll go to some other world.」

574:t_2:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「And turn people into $$次元獣$$s there!?」

574:t_2:20.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「Now that I've seen the likes of you, even I have to change my thinking.」

574:t_2:21.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「Rather than turning them into $$次元獣$$s and capping their strength there, I'd have to find warriors who grow without limit, or I won't beat them.」

574:t_2:22.en:
$$ヴァイシュラバ$$
「That's how it is, brother. If we meet in the Heavenly Prison, let's fight together.」

575:t_000:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Ships and units of $c confirmed in the surrounding area. All units are safe.」

575:t_000:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So everyone who was there got thrown to Earth, huh.」

575:t_000:5.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「For now, I'm praying it's not some other planet.」

575:t_000:6.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Working out our current position from the terrain...」

575:t_000:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$ＺＯＮＥ$$ confirmed to the southeast!」

575:t_001:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No doubt about it... That's a 《$$ＺＯＮＥ$$》.」

575:t_001:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But it's smaller than the ones we know.」

575:t_001:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Units launching from the facilities around the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ confirmed!」

575:t_002:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's the $$アークセイバー$$!」

575:t_002:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Those people... were on Earth all along.」

575:t_002:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「But why are they riding $$ディム・サー$$s? They should be Federation members too...」

575:t_002:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, let's confirm the situation. Open the communication line.」

575:t_002:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「This is $$スメラギ・李・ノリエガ$$ of $c. $$アークセイバー$$, please respond.」

575:t_002:7.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Don't tell me these guys... investigated $$インサラウム$$ in advance!」

575:t_002:9.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Maybe those people... don't know that $c has been formed.」

575:t_002:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We're former 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》 members. We got thrown here by some trouble, but...」

575:t_002:11.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「So you are the visitors from that $$時空震動$$ earlier!」

575:t_002:13.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「No, we won't be fooled! If it was an accident, then why do you know about us!」

575:t_002:14.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「These guys...! Are they invaders from a parallel world, targeting the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom!」

575:t_002:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You mean it's 《$$インサラウム$$》...!」

575:t_002:18.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「But Earth in that world was supposed to have been destroyed when $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ went out of control!」

575:t_003:0.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「$$インサラウム$$ destroyed, you say!?」

575:t_003:1.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We won't let that happen! All units, begin the attack!」

575:t_003:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What do we do, $$スメラギ$$!?」

575:t_003:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...We can't talk in this situation. Fall back, so we can regroup with the others too!」

575:t_003:4.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「I'm using $$トランザム$$! Stay with me, $$クロウ$$!」

575:t_003:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「(Could it be that this is... my fault...)」

575:t_004:1.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Set up a perimeter alert at once and contact the Holy Capital! Depending on the situation, we may have to request a $$ハイナイト$$ deployment!」

575:t_006:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Those pitch-black bastards we saw in that mysterious universe!」

575:t_006:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Did the $$アークセイバー$$ get wiped out by them!」
